articles.title: 'Shopping for free': Students loot LPU campus mall; torch computer science block
articles.description: Several videos from Lovely Professional University show students reportedly taking items from shops during protests. The protests were sparked by allegations surrounding the rape of a female student and a student's suicide. Police reported clashes, stone-pelting, and damage to property during the unrest, escalated by social media rumors. An investigation has been initiated, while the university has denied the rape allegations as false.

articles.title: Growing sexual assault cases in Delhi: SC draws parallel to 2012 Nirbhaya gangrape
articles.description: The Supreme Court has shown deep concern regarding the increasing cases of sexual assault in Delhi. It has drawn parallels with the notorious 2012 Nirbhaya case to emphasize the issue. The court noted a systematic failure of law enforcement agencies in addressing these incidents. In response to the problem, the court took suo motu cognizance and registered a case.

articles.title: Video: Ujjain tensions flare after clash over part of Shahi mosque demolition
articles.description: A large crowd clashed with police in Ujjain due to plans to demolish part of the Shahi Masjid. Stone-throwing individuals intensified the situation, prompting police to intervene and control the unrest. Authorities deployed heavy police force to maintain order in the area following the clash. Tear-gas shells were used by police in an effort to disperse the crowd. This incident is currently being reported as a developing story.

articles.title: 'We have a serious problem': CJP's Abhijeet Dipke reacts to LPU unrest
articles.description: Protests erupted at Lovely Professional University in Punjab following allegations of a rape committed on campus. Students vandalized property and clashed with police, resulting in several injuries and damaged vehicles. In response to the unrest, the university suspended classes for ten days and advised students to stay indoors. A police investigation into the alleged rape is underway, while the university denied the claims as rumors.

articles.description: The initiative would have restricted Switzerland from joining sanctions against other countries unless those measures had been imposed by the United Nations. articles.title: Rhode Island federal judge orders revival of $7 billion Solar for All program canceled in 2025
articles.description: A Rhode Island federal judge has ordered the revival of the $7 billion Solar for All program after the Trump administration’s EPA canceled it in August 2025. Judge Mary S. McElroy ruled the agency overstepped its authority in terminating the Biden-era initiative, which aimed to expand solar access for low-income households nationwide.

articles.title: Sister Stephanie Baliga: From aspiring elite runner to nun raising $2.6 million, and she’s still running

Now, she continues running and fundraising through Team OLA.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Taylor Swift remembers in her speech for the Video of the Year award
articles.description: Taylor Swift recently won the Video of the Year award at the MTV VMAs for her song ‘Fate of Ophelia.' She accepted the award after being recognized for her work as a director and an artist. Swift dedicated her award to Dolly Parton, highlighting the impact of her songwriting and stories. During her speech, she expressed gratitude for her fans and her experiences in the industry.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran called a 'red-headed puppet' on 'SNL UK' - WATCH
articles.description: Amelia Dimoldenberg made a joke about Ed Sheeran during her SNL UK monologue, comparing him to a puppet. This reference followed the controversy surrounding Macklemore being dropped from Sheeran's US tour for supporting Palestine. Sheeran clarified that he did not make the decision to remove Macklemore, attributing it to the tour promoters. The situation escalated with other supporting acts withdrawing in solidarity with Macklemore.

articles.title: Parineeti Chopra recalls crying throughout her first work trip
articles.description: Parineeti Chopra expressed her feelings of overwhelming emotional pain when she left her baby for the first time. She reflected on the journey back to Bombay, which she could barely remember due to her distress. Despite knowing her baby was safe with family, she experienced intense mom guilt commonly faced by working mothers. Chopra also questioned societal expectations placed on women regarding work and motherhood.
